digest.component_or_area: reconciler Jira adapter and vendor-neutral mapping core
propositions: rebar reconciler hardcodes per-project workflow variance mappings (status, type, priority, link relations) in multiple locations, preventing support for projects with non-standard workflows without core edits

the seam must enable config-driven status, type, and link-relation mappings via rebar.toml with layered precedence (built-in default → config default → per-project overlay) and remain provider-neutral

type and transition mapping must support four strategies for unmapped target concepts: map to a chosen value, collapse non-injectably with rebar-type: labels, skip whole-ticket types, or drift with warnings
failed target transitions must be replayed using the ticket's persisted core STATUS event log, attempting each recorded hop exactly once and degrading to drift on failure
non-representable parent relationships must drift and leave an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key
all mapping axes (status, type, link relation, priority) must be driven by the config seam rather than hardcoded literals, with built-in defaults as fallback
